jobs.description:
Job Description
Come join our passionate team! Barracuda is a leading cybersecurity company providing complete protection against complex threats. Our platform protects email, data, applications, and networks with innovative solutions, and a managed XDR service, to strengthen cyber resilience. Hundreds of thousands of IT professionals and managed service providers worldwide trust us to protect and support them with solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use.
We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.
Envision yourself at Barracuda:
We are looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer II to join our growing team and help us develop cutting\-edge Machine Learning detection solutions for our email protection products. As part of the Efficacy engineering team, you will be responsible for designing and implementing innovative machine learning algorithms that can analyze vast amounts of data and detect threats in real\-time. You will be part of a team that is responsible for detecting email threats across our customers. You possess strong technical hands\-on experience in delivering use cases and detection rules for multiple attack vectors through Machine learning. You help by developing detection methods to make sure we can identify potential threats and take action to stop them. This is an excellent opportunity to work with an elite team of security engineers and make a real impact in the field of cybersecurity. You will collaborate with other team members every day. Being a team player is necessary for being successful in this role along with having an innovative and forward\-facing mindset. You will be a leader within the team and act as a mentor to other team members.
What you'll be working on:
* Analyze vast amounts of data to identify threats and devise innovative algorithms to detect them in real\-time
* Research and develop new email threat detections to support the ever\-changing cyber space
* Build and train machine learning classifiers to detect attacks across our email protection products
* Evaluate the performance of your algorithms and continuously optimize them
* Collaborate with an elite team of machine learning and software engineers to scale your algorithms and bring them to production
* Leverage the latest AI to accelerate delivery of detection solutions
* Work with cutting\-edge technologies in a fast\-paced environment
* Communicate clearly and effectively, both written and orally, the risks that exist and remediations required for any security incident.
* Work collaboratively and independently on unique or special assignments which may require specialized knowledge and/or experience

**What you will bring to the role:*** Bachelor's degree in computer science or electrical engineering. An advanced degree is a plus; or equivalent work experience
* 2\-4 years of experience in creating and maintaining machine learning models
* Proven track record in developing production\-grade machine learning algorithms that solve practical problems
* 2\+ years of experience in analyzing large structured and unstructured data using Python (or other relevant languages)
* Visceral understanding of probability and supervised/unsupervised learning
* Experience working with Databricks and SQL.
* Hands on experience with cloud architecture such AWS or Azure is a plus.
* Experience with Deep learning is a plus
* Hands\-on experience with MLOps tools (MLFlow) for model deployment and inference is a plus.
* Experience with Identity Access Graph/Knowledge graphs and Graph modelling is a huge plus.
* Experience in cybersecurity is a plus
* Experience using AI features for model inference LLMs, RAG systems, and evaluation frameworks is a plus
* Entrepreneurial spirit and extreme sense of ownership
* Deep desire to make our customers happy and provide best\-in\-class machine learning detections

**What you’ll get from us:**
A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Atlys**


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**


We're looking for a **Backend Engineer** to build the services and systems that power visa processing for travellers around the world, from the APIs behind our apps to the pipelines that file every application.


You'll design and own Python services that connect government portals, payment providers, document pipelines and our AI systems, and keep them fast, reliable and correct as we scale across countries and volume.


This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves clean systems design, and who gets as much satisfaction from a service that quietly works at peak load as from shipping a new feature.

**The Job**

* **Build the core platform** by designing and shipping Python services and APIs that power applications, payments, document handling and order tracking across 127 countries.
* **Integrate with the real world** by building robust integrations with government portals, embassies, payment gateways and partners, handling retries, rate limits, flaky endpoints and ever\-changing rules gracefully.
* **Scale for volume** by designing data models, queues and async workflows that hold up through peak travel seasons and sudden spikes in demand.
* **Put AI into production** by working closely with our AI team to turn LLM\-powered agents and document intelligence pipelines into reliable, observable backend services.
* **Own systems end to end** by taking work from design to production, including deployment, monitoring, alerting and incident follow\-ups, with a high bar for testing and security since we handle passports and financial documents.

**The Ideal Candidate**


You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 2\-5 years of backend engineering experience, building and running production systems at meaningful scale.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and have shipped production services with frameworks such as FastAPI, Django or Flask.
* Have solid fundamentals in databases and distributed systems, including PostgreSQL, Redis, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS or Celery), caching and async processing.
* Are comfortable with cloud infrastructure and modern tooling such as AWS or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability stacks.
* Have exposure to browser automation (Playwright, Selenium), integrating LLM APIs, or building in fintech, travel or other high\-compliance domains (a strong plus).

**Here's what you can expect:**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer II, Hyderabad
jobs.description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Machine Learning Engineer II, Hyderabad**

 **About Warner Bros. Discovery:**


Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non\-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.


For more information, please visit www.wbd.com.

 **Meet our Team**


Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) brings together iconic entertainment, news, and sports brands including HBO Max, CNN, Discovery\+, DC, Warner Bros., Bleacher Report, and Food Network. Within the SPARK organization, our Hyderabad Machine Learning Engineering team turns first\-party audience signals into ML capabilities for identity, audience intelligence, advertising, personalization, forecasting, engagement, and retention.


At WBD, MLEs do rigorous data science *and* own the engineering that brings models to life: production ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and the ML infrastructure — feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps — that make our work reliable, repeatable, and scalable. We build primarily on **Databricks**, with strong working knowledge of **Snowflake** and **AWS**, and we are an early, enthusiastic adopter of agentic AI development workflows.

**About the Role**


As a Machine Learning Engineer II on the Hyderabad SPARK team, you will be a hands\-on builder of production ML systems across WBD’s consumer platforms. You will translate data science ideas into reliable pipelines, models, and services that support identity, audience intelligence, advertising, personalization, forecasting, engagement, and retention use cases.


You will work closely with senior engineers, data scientists, product managers, and platform teams to build reproducible ML workflows, improve model quality, and help operate models with strong monitoring, governance, and production\-readiness practices.

 **What You’ll Do** :

 **Technical Execution \& Delivery**

* Build and operate low\-latency online serving systems for fraud scoring, message decisioning, and real\-time personalization.
* Develop ML models for identity resolution, audience intelligence, content\-affinity modeling, genre\-preference modeling, and time\-series forecasting across global markets.
* Integrate with personalization and activation systems to consume in\-app user signals and deliver model outputs into downstream workflows.
* Implement feature pipelines that combine real\-time streaming signals with batch\-computed features for online scoring.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to translate business problems into well\-scoped ML solutions.
* Contributes to evaluations of new technologies and approaches, including DCR\-native modeling, graph ML, agentic ML orchestration, and LLM\-augmented pipelines.

**Production ML Systems**

* Build and improve **probabilistic identity resolution** components that connect unauthenticated device IDs and first\-party cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence across WBD brands.
* Contribute to **Audience Intelligence** capabilities, including ML Promo Optimizer, STAT v2, lookalike modeling inside Snowflake DCR, and content segmentation.
* Develop and productionize **forecasting** models for use cases such as audience growth, demand, yield, and pricing, ensuring models are monitored and continuously improved.
* Bring ML personalization signals, such as genre/content affinity and engagement trends, into batch and future real\-time activation paths.
* Implement MLOps workflows for experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, retraining, monitoring, and drift detection.

**Experimentation, Quality \& Observability**

* Implement offline and online evaluation approaches with clear baselines, success metrics, experiment design, and promotion criteria.
* Improve feature and label quality, leakage prevention, bias checks, calibration, explainability where applicable, and impact measurement.
* Identify technical risks early, document tradeoffs, and partner with engineering, data, product, and business stakeholders on mitigation plans.
* Turn incidents and postmortems into reusable learnings, automated checks, and platform improvements.
* Apply production\-readiness practices such as testability, data quality checks, rollback paths, drift monitoring, and dashboards.

**Cross\-functional Partnership \& Mentorship**

* Partner with ML leads on execution planning, technical design, capability development, and delivery of production ML systems.
* Represent the Hyderabad team in technical discussions with ML, Data Engineering, Product, Ad Sales, and US\-based stakeholders.
* Create clear design docs, readiness reviews, runbooks, and postmortem notes that strengthen engineering culture.
* Support junior engineers through implementation guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* 3–5 years of ML engineering experience, or 2\+ years with a Ph.D., with demonstrated ownership of production ML components and cross\-functional delivery

jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

  

  

**Invent the future with us.**  

  

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high\-performance, energy efficient AI compute.  

  

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high\-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.  

  

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team \- we’d love to have you apply!  

  

**About the role:**  

Ampere is hiring a senior individual contributor to build the engineering foundation for enterprise AI. The role covers platform services, knowledge and retrieval systems, MCP integrations, and agent workflows.


This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will make design decisions, write production code, establish technical standards, and remain accountable for the systems after release. You will work with engineering, data, IT, security, and business teams to deliver AI capabilities that are secure, reliable, and useful.

 **What you’ll achieve:**  

* Build and operate shared services, APIs, automations, and integrations that allow teams to use approved AI models, enterprise data, and business tools.
* Improve reliability, performance, deployment, monitoring, logging, incident response, and operating documentation.
* Set implementation standards and build common components that reduce duplicated work across AI initiatives.
* Develop embedding, indexing, and retrieval methods for technical and enterprise knowledge.
* Improve search quality through hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, access\-aware retrieval, reranking, query processing, source citations, and evaluation.
* Apply appropriate data structures and algorithms to search, ranking, caching, state management, and performance.
* Build test sets and measurement methods for retrieval accuracy, grounding, latency, cost, and failure handling.
* Design and implement MCP clients, servers, and tool integrations for enterprise systems.
* Define tool interfaces, schemas, authentication, authorization, approval flows, audit records, and lifecycle practices.
* Build and maintain integrations with engineering, knowledge, ticketing, source\-control, data, and business systems.
* Maintain a managed tool catalog with ownership, access controls, versioning, test coverage, monitoring, and retirement practices.
* Build agent workflows that plan tasks, call tools, retain execution state, request approval when needed, and recover from failure.
* Implement scheduling, retries, checkpoints, cancellation, escalation, and human review for long\-running work.
* Set controls for agent permissions, credential scope, tool risk, evidence capture, and auditability.
* Measure task completion, tool outcomes, workflow quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Apply enterprise identity and security requirements across AI services, including OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, managed identities, RBAC, secrets management, and least\-privilege access.
* Address prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool access, excessive permissions, and poor source provenance.
* Work with security and platform teams to maintain the controls, monitoring, and operating practices required for enterprise AI

 **About you:**  

* M.Tech in Computer Engineering or related field with 3\+ years of experience or B.Tech in Computer Engineering or releated field with 5\+ years of experience
* 3\+ years of experience building production software, platform services, developer tools, data systems, or applied AI products.
* Strong software\-engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, API design, schema design, asynchronous systems, testing, debugging, and performance analysis.
* Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, plus experience building and maintaining React applications.
* Experience building APIs, integrations, background jobs, automations, and services that use enterprise authentication and authorization.
* Experience with LLM applications, tool calling, structured outputs, semantic search, retrieval systems, or agent workflows.
* Experience with embeddings, hybrid search, metadata design, ranking, access\-aware retrieval, retrieval evaluation, and vector or search infrastructure.
* Experience with MCP or comparable tool\-integration protocols, including tool contracts, schemas, authentication, authorization, and lifecycle management.
* Experience designing reliable workflows with state management, retries, idempotency, checkpoints, cancellation, and audit trails.
* Working knowledge of Linux, Git, Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, logging, and production incident response.
* Sound security judgment across identity, access control, secrets, sensitive data, and AI\-specific threats

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Rust and Tauri experience, or experience building native desktop applications.
* Azure experience, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and Azure VMs.
* Experience with search and vector platforms such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or Chroma.
* Experience with workflow orchestration, event\-driven systems, queues, schedulers, state machines, or durable execution platforms.
* Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform, Bicep, or similar tools.
* Experience with Redis, caching, rate limiting, telemetry, usage analytics, capacity planning, or cost management.
* Experience with pytest, Vitest, Playwright, contract testing, integration testing, or AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience in semiconductor, advanced computing, developer platform, or enterprise engineering environments.

 **What we’ll offer:**  

  

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewar

jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Expert\-level engineer designing and building LLM applications and agentic workflows on Azure: RAG pipelines, multi\-agent orchestration, MCP tool integration, evaluation, guardrails and cost control. Sets the GenAI engineering standards for the account and is accountable for solution quality against agreed evaluation thresholds.


##### **Responsibilities**


Build LLM applications and agent workflows with LangGraph / LangChain / Semantic Kernel on Azure OpenAI (AWS Bedrock / GCP Vertex a plus).


Design RAG pipelines: document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search (Azure AI Search, FAISS, Pinecone), hybrid retrieval and re\-ranking.


Integrate enterprise tools and context via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and function / tool calling; design multi\-agent systems.


Engineer, version and test prompts; run offline and online evaluations (accuracy, grounding, hallucination rate) and fine\-tuning where justified.


Implement responsible\-AI guardrails (content filters, PII redaction, policy checks) and LLM observability (tracing, token accounting, latency).


Optimise token and inference cost (model routing, caching, batching); report against cost budgets.


Document prompts, evaluation results and model choices; mentor engineers adopting GenAI patterns.


##### **Skills**


Must have


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


10\+ years in software or data engineering, of which 3\+ in machine learning / NLP and 2\+ delivering production LLM applications (RAG, agents) on Azure OpenAI or equivalent.


Expert Python; LangGraph, LangChain and/or Semantic Kernel; asynchronous, event\-driven application design.


Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry / ML, Functions, Container Apps / AKS, Key Vault, Application Insights.

Guardrails (Azure AI Content Safety, NeMo Guardrails or similar), LLM observability (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry), FinOps for inference.

AWS Bedrock or GCP Vertex AI.


Semantic caching, model distillation, small\-language\-model deployment.
